Author: twelvehouse
Name: Linkpearl
Description:
Linkpearl streams your FFXIV chat to any browser in real time and lets you reply from anywhere. It also includes an OpenAI-compatible AI assistant that can auto-reply, offer multiple reply options, or suggest replies in selected channels.

Features:
- Real-time chat streaming via Server-Sent Events
- Supports all channel types: FC, LS/CWLS 1-8, Party, Tell, Say, Shout, Yell, Alliance, and more
- Custom filters with drag-and-drop reordering, unread badges, and default send channels
- Tell mode with pin support and recent DM history
- Send queue with a short countdown so you can cancel accidental sends
- Emote picker with search and recently used, plus an FFXIV symbol picker
- Link previews for trusted sites (Lodestone, YouTube, Twitter/X, Twitch, and more)
- AI assistant with multiple custom agents, per-channel trigger rules, cooldown/rate limits, and three reply modes
- Chinese/English interface shared by the browser and in-game windows (Chinese by default)
- Appearance customisation: Light and Dark themes, Google Fonts, font size, coloured message backgrounds
- Passcode authentication for browser access

Usage:
- Open the settings with /linkpearl; open the AI assistant with /linkpearl ai
- Set a 4-8 digit passcode under Security, then open the shown URL in your browser
- Configure the AI provider (Base URL, API Key, model) and add agents/rules under Settings -> AI Assistant
Punchline: Real-time web chat relay for FFXIV with an AI assistant, in and out of game.
